column1: # Postcode centroid files as the builder's encoder writes them (builder/src/postcode_files.h):
# what the case covers, the logical rows (lat and lng f32 bits in hex, postcode_id, country_code
# in hex, cell key in hex; ...; - for none), and postcode_centroids.bin and
# postcode_centroid_cells.bin as hex (- for an empty file). The builder's tests encode the rows
# to the files and decode them back; the server's read the rows from the files and its test
# encoder (postcode_files.rs) must write the same files.
